notes: v2.5.39. The 3D viewer manages parts from the model: a right-click console for status, release, rev, engineer, due, star, CMF and records, multi-select with box select, colour by Released, Owner or Priority, a hidden space, faster first opens and one build progress bar. The eBOM grid gets header column filters, a Settings dialog with column order, one-confirm releases of a whole tree with revs saved in the background, a restyled release email, numbered issues with an Issues tab, live updates for everyone and a default model open. CMF follows the eBOM into builds and the CMF page takes bulk edits. Conversion problems say who fixes them, routers and travelers can be deleted and restored, incident response tickets are in, and retired vendor parts are never offered for linking.
